name: @pipeworx/mcp-huggingface

tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Search Hugging Face Hub models with filters for author, library (transformers/diffusers/…), language, pipeline_tag (text-generation/…), and tags; sort by downloads, likes, or trendingScore.

language.description: ISO language code, e.g. "fr" — matched as a Hub tag, not validated

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search Hugging Face Hub datasets with filters for author, language, and task_categories; sort by downloads, likes, or lastModified; returns dataset id, downloads, likes, and tags.

tools.name: search_spaces
tools.description: Search Hugging Face Spaces (demo apps) with filters for author and SDK (gradio/streamlit/docker/static); returns space id, sdk, runtime status, and likes.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Detailed model info — config, tags, downloads, files at root.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Detailed Hugging Face dataset metadata by repo_id (e.g. "squad") and optional revision; returns card data, tags, downloads, task categories, and file list.

tools.name: get_space
tools.description: Detailed Hugging Face Space metadata by repo_id (e.g. "stabilityai/stable-diffusion") and optional revision; returns sdk, runtime status, likes, and linked models.

tools.name: list_model_files
tools.description: Hugging Face Hub API — list the files in a model repository at a given revision (branch, tag or commit; main by default) and optional subdirectory path. Returns each entry's path, type, byte size and blob SHA, including LFS details for weight shards. Answers which weight, config and tokenizer files ship in a Hugging Face model repo and how large they are.

tools.name: list_dataset_files
tools.description: List files in a Hugging Face dataset repository by repo_id and optional revision/subdirectory path; returns filename, size, and blob SHA for each file.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-huggingface forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the huggingface pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
